recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.method: Boil the spaghetti. Fry the guanciale until crispy. Mix egg yolks, Pecorino and black pepper. Combine everything off the heat with some pasta water.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.method: Boil the spaghetti. Fry the onion, carrot and minced beef. Add tomato passata and simmer until cooked. Mix with spaghetti.

recipes.name: Penne Arrabbiata
recipes.method: Boil the penne. Fry garlic and chilli flakes in olive oil. Add tomatoes and simmer. Toss the pasta in the sauce and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.method: Boil the fettuccine. Add butter and grated Parmesan with a little pasta water. Toss until a creamy sauce forms. Season with black pepper.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
recipes.method: Boil the spaghetti. Gently cook sliced garlic and chilli flakes in olive oil. Add spaghetti and some pasta water. Toss everything together and finish with parsley.
